native_checks_context: Windows IngeTrazo API2; 79 regression, 39 member-library/point-placement, 27 drawing, 16 native copy/adoption and 62 per-type reinforcement recipe and 23 analytical graph checks. Native Qt mouse/key and visible framebuffer preview verified. Default technical renderer and five vector PDF frames verified; original blank document unchanged. Family10 whole-project evidence remains 0.7.1.

pdf_verification.visual_review: All five Poppler-rendered pages inspected; explicit levels separated with leaders; synthetic coordination fixture, not construction design

limitations: Analytical geometry only; no solver/materials/supports/releases/offsets/loads or torsional stiffness; solver_ready=false
Analytical conversion limited to 1000 Beam/Column members; interior crossings/near joints not automatically connected; node IDs change with coordinates
Starter model-based coordination sheets, not complete construction documents or LOD350 certification
Fixed world-axis orientations: front -Y, side +X; one plan cut and one X section; floor-by-floor sets not implemented
Grid and levels are explicit user project coordinates, not inferred or checked against the building
Automatic dimensions are grid spacing and source model extents, including roof overhangs; member/opening dimensions remain manual
Manual sheet edits are preserved and block regeneration; retain them in separate native sheets before regenerating
Vector rendering limited to 5000 source faces; technical rendering available for larger scopes, not benchmarked on whole Family10 in this release
Architectural/MEP generators and PDF/OCR remain unimplemented
Type library is local project/shared JSON; no bulk propagation; reinforcement recipes require explicit actual Host review
New placement needs no Grid; Z fixed; horizontal beams/slabs, simple polygon without holes and directed straight stairs only
Polygon slab reinforcement blocked; existing rectangular cages must not substitute for the outline
Stair second point sets ascent direction, not overall run; no landings or L/U flights
User-defined reinforcement details are not strength design or certified standard compliance; existing 0.8.0 detailing limitations apply
publication_note: Line endings normalized to LF; original installed/native-tested hashes retained.
